definitions.explanation: A play, film, or TV drama set in the past and based on historical events or figures. In Japan, samurai-era stories are a common subject.

examples.japanese: {歴史劇|れきしげき}が{好|す}きだ。
この{歴史劇|れきしげき}は{戦国|せんごく}{時代|じだい}が{舞台|ぶたい}だ。
examples.english: This historical drama is set in the Warring States period.

examples.japanese: {歴史劇|れきしげき}は{史実|しじつ}をもとにしながらも、{物語|ものがたり}として{脚色|きゃくしょく}されている。
examples.english: Historical dramas are based on historical fact but are dramatized into a story.

notes:
Compound of {歴史|れきし} (history) + {劇|げき} (play, drama). Covers stage plays as well as film and television set in the past.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {歴史劇|れきしげき}を{上演|じょうえん}する: to stage a historical drama

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {時代劇|じだいげき}: period drama — specifically pre-Meiji (samurai-era) Japanese settings
- {大河|たいが}ドラマ: NHK's year-long historical drama series
